scope: Client read/list contract only: committed GraphQL SDL at the revisions above plus one read-only live introspection and query replay. No mutation, watch or write behavior is verified.

variant.list: productVariants(namespace: String!, first, after, last, before)
variant.clientProjection: core subset: title, sku, productRef, selectedOptions, inventory, status conditions, body; pricing, media and resolved status are not projected

file.list: files(namespace: String!, first, after, last, before): FileConnection!

serviceaccount.shape: id, apiVersion, kind, metadata, keyIDs, groups, lifecycle; no spec, status or body
serviceaccount.mutations: exist upstream; list-only in the CLI

alpha9ToAlpha12Compatibility.method: Diff of shared/schemas/**/*.graphqls between the baseline and alpha.12 revisions
changes: additions: files list, FileConnection, serviceAccounts list, ProductVariant and Collection watch subscriptions, rbac/translation/user schemas
ServiceAccount: Actor status replaced by lifecycle and groups; Node interface added
optional input additions: resource-termination uid, RBAC resourceVersion
alpha9ToAlpha12Compatibility.watchHandling: Typed watch keeps requiring the alpha.9 profile; alpha.12 bookmark/resume semantics are not verified

liveCheck.method: Read-only introspection of the Query type and replay of the four generated queries (list variant, read variant, list file, list serviceaccount)
liveCheck.result: All four queries passed GraphQL validation. Variant and file lists returned no rows, so those projections were not exercised on real nodes; the service account list returned one node with the full projection.
